title: Head of Loan Distribution Group APAC
description:
Internal Job Posting: Head of Loan Distribution Group (LDG) – APAC

Location: Singapore
Team: c. 12 professionals across Singapore, Hong Kong, and Sydney
Reporting Lines: Global Head of LDG (FLM) and Regional Head of CMA-APAC (HLM)

Role Overview

The Loan Distribution Group (LDG) APAC is ING’s dedicated, fully integrated underwriting and distribution platform for all financing activities in the primary and secondary loan markets across Asia-Pacific. The platform also utilizes the insurance market as a risk and/or capital distribution tool and is responsible for structuring and executing various structured distribution solutions (including Forward Flow Partnerships, Structured Portfolio Sales, and Significant Risk Transfers). LDG APAC is ING's “centre of excellence” for the end-to-end distribution value chain—from origination, to structuring and execution, and actual selldown. LDG APAC is a key part of the Capital Velocity value chain.

Purpose of the Position

The Head of LDG APAC manages the APAC-based LDG businesses, overseeing teams in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Sydney. This senior management position requires strategic vision, broad experience, in-depth product knowledge, and excellent relationship and leadership skills. The role reports functionally to the Global Head of LDG and hierarchically to the Region Head of CMA-APAC.
The position is also a core member of both the Global LDG Management Team (MT) and the CMA APAC Management Team (MT).

Team Leadership

LDG APAC consists of c. 12 FTEs across three major financial hubs. As people manager, you will foster a highly engaged and integrated department spanning multiple locations.  Critically important will be talent identification, professional development and implementing successorship plans.

Key Responsibilities

Candidate Profile

Interested candidates should contact HR, or the LDG and/or CMA-APAC leadership teams for further details.

title: Associate, Transaction Services Account Management (TSAM)
description:
About ING

ING Bank covers Wholesale and Retail Banking in Asia Pacific. Our Wholesale Banking business is present and active in 11 major economies in the Asia Pacific, namely China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam.

Step into a role where execution meets impact

At ING, Transaction Services plays a critical role in helping clients move, manage, and grow their businesses across borders. As ING continues to expand its Transaction Services footprint in Asia, this role offers the opportunity to be close to complex deals, meaningful collaboration, and real business impact — without losing sight of operational excellence.

If you bring a strong foundation in operations or credit and are ready to apply that expertise closer to the commercial side of the business, this role could be your next step.

Role summary

As an Associate in Transaction Services Account Management, you will support the growth and development of ING’s Transaction Services business in Taiwan. You will focus on ensuring smooth execution of locally booked transactions, strong risk and compliance standards, and effective coordination across local and regional stakeholders.

This is an individual contributor role that combines transaction oversight, risk awareness, and business support in an international Wholesale Banking environment.

About the team

You will join the Transaction Services team in Taiwan, part of ING Wholesale Banking. The team works closely with Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver trade finance and cash management solutions to corporate clients.

The role reports to the Head of Transaction Services, Taiwan, and offers exposure to both local execution and regional coordination. Client interaction is part of the role, typically alongside or through senior team members.

What you bring

title: Consumer Media Expert – Campaign Lead
description:
At ING, we do banking differently. We’re a human, challenger brand focused on making money simpler and more relevant for Australians. Our marketing is known for being distinctive, insight‑led and genuinely useful—and we’re always evolving how we connect with customers through ideas, media and partnerships that cut through.

To support this ambition, we’ve created a new role: Consumer Media Expert – Campaign Lead. This role is about shaping proactive, campaign‑led communications that bring brand and product together through strong storytelling and smart media choices. You’ll focus on how our messages live in culture—across platforms, partnerships and content—building impact through integration rather than isolated activity.

It’s a strategic role for someone who thrives on connecting brand and product stories through campaigns, media and partnerships, and who’s excited by the opportunity to think big about how ING shows up in the world.

Ready to make an impact?

What you’ll do

What we’re looking for

What’s in it for you?

About Us

At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding - for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us, and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed - it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive, and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can do your thing.

Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values - not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply

Sound like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!

(One last note: We operate using a direct talent sourcing model, so no agency introductions, please.)

ING is Australia’s most recommended bank according to RFI Global’s Consumer Atlas Survey, January–June 2025 (n = 29,510) when compared to customers of the 10 largest ADIs operating in Australia.

Need more?

Contact: Skye Griffiths on skye.griffiths@ing.com

For support and adjustments, including DEI, LGBTQI+ confidential application support enquiries: rpoteam.au@ing.com

Applications close Friday 20 February

Before you apply
Here at ING we consider employee development to be important and encourage existing employees to apply for suitable internal positions. It is expected that any employee applying for a vacant position would have been in their current role for a minimum of twelve (12) months before applying. What you will do

What you bring

What we offer

Exposure to a key growth business within ING Wholesale Banking

How to apply

Click the apply button on our career site and submit your application via Workday, ING’s official recruitment system.

Job Application Safety Reminder⚠️

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site.

Check the sender’s email carefully: legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com

No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Intern, Commodities, Food and Agriculture HK
description:
Why ING?

The world of banking is changing faster than ever. That’s why we at ING are always broadening our horizons. Our people have a forward-thinking mentality, a strong can-do spirit and enjoy working in an agile environment.

ING in Asia Pacific

In Asia Pacific, ING offers wholesale banking across 11 markets, namely Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

ING offers both retail and wholesale banking services in Australia. ING’s regional presence includes a 13% stake in Bank of Beijing, China and a 30% stake in TMBThanachart Bank in Thailand.

Singapore is the regional headquarters for ING's Wholesale Banking (WB) business in Asia, which includes all WB business lines such as Financial Markets, Strategic Products, Sectors, Lending and Transaction Services and other support functions.

Commodities, Food and Agriculture (CF&A)

CF&A is a global leading team, consisting of more than 250 professionals dedicated to providing financial solutions to clients involved in the trading of physical commodities (energy, metals and minerals, and agriculture), as well as the producers and processors of metals and minerals, and food and agricultural products.

Overview

The CF&A internship offers a unique opportunity for individuals seeking hands-on experience in the dynamic world of commodity financing. Interns will support key CF&A activities within the client-facing Front Office Team, working closely with various internal stakeholders.

Interns will be immersed in a collaborative environment that fosters learning and will gain invaluable experience into the workings of a global financial institution.

Duties and Responsibilities

Front Office

Client Management

Together with the Account Officer (AO), you have the responsibility to help the AO in managing banking services (including transactional trade finance products) offered to clients (or prospective clients)

Liaise with clients within the portfolio in deal management / transaction requests and ensuring that proposed deals are in conformity of the bank’s risk appetite and/or approved credit facility parameters

Work closely with  relevant product partners  (including  Middle Office, Risk, Operations, Financial Markets, among others) to ensure smooth and timely execution of transactions, and timely completion of credit reviews/credit modifications

Assist in credit & operational tasks including credit reviews, customer due diligence management, call reports, covenant monitoring and management reporting

Participate in ad-hoc projects or assignments, reporting, commercial and clients’ meetings where necessary

What are the skill and qualification requirements of the role?

Minimum GPA of 3/4 or equivalent

Strong  analytical skills and the ability to execute tasks efficiently

Resourceful and proactive mindset  to learning and problem solving

Positive attitude in dealing with challenging and difficult situations

Need more information?

For information on ING Wholesale Bank, visit https://www.ingwb.com/

For information on careers, visit https://www.ing.jobs/Global/Careers.htm
